data.desc: Stem is a global leader in energy intelligence and the operating system for clean energy: where assets connect, sites are optimized, and value is captured. Powered by decades of operational experience and purpose-built AI, our PowerTrack platform is the layer that sits between raw data and confident action, making every decision-maker smarter, every asset more productive, and every transition more certain. From asset monitoring to portfolio optimization and control, PowerTrack delivers everything energy professionals need in one place. With projects managed across 55 countries, we have spent nearly 20 years empowering asset owners, operators, and developers to take command of what comes next, with the certainty to act, the trust to commit, and the intelligence to lead.
